article.story: POCATELLO, Idaho -- — Isaiah Moses scored 22 points as Eastern Washington beat Idaho State 84-66 on Saturday. Moses also had five rebounds for the Eagles (4-14, 2/3 Big Sky Conference). Alton Hamilton IV scored 15 points while shooting 5 of 11 from the field and 5 of 6 from the line to go with nine rebounds. Johnny Radford shot 3 of 5 from the field and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points. Connor Hollenbeck led the way for the Bengals (10-9, 3-3) with 15 points. Idaho State also got 12 points from Martin Kheil. Evan Otten had 10 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
